title: The Ribbon Has a Name
hook: I-5, then I-90. The kit is in back.
scene: The Menace is parked on a wide paved shoulder just before the I-5 south ramp, engine still, key in. Overcast midday. You are alone. Yuna is on the radio: I-5 south, I-90 east, valley floor only. CARGO is the relay kit lashed behind the seats: repeater set, antenna, mast clamps. It already fits. No second vehicle. The mountain sits in the east as a shape, not a road. The schedule does not climb today.
debrief: Parked: cluster at zero, empty passenger seat, kit behind you. Yuna named the Ribbon. The log stops at the valley floor.

source.teaching_target: Establish the Ribbon and the locked load: relay kit (repeater, antenna, mast clamps) already sized for the Menace. Ali alone. Yuna on radio.

image_brief.subject: Ali Okonjo chest-up in the parked Pink Menace, braid over the left shoulder, wire-rim glasses, flat affect
image_brief.foreground: worn black leather wheel rim and cracked pink dash, empty passenger seat
image_brief.midground: welded steel mesh and still wipers, no motion in the glass
image_brief.background: overcast midday shoulder, I-5 ramps soft and distant, no snow, no night
image_brief.read: Ali is parked and alone; the wheels are still; the mountain is only a distant shape
extra_negatives: no antenna mounted as a new Menace mark
